findings.claim: 公司稱AI需求未見天花板，預期2026年營收逐季成長、下半年優於上半年，全年目標雙位數成長；探針卡約佔七成營收；產能供不應求，仍面臨缺工缺電。
2026年3月法說：探針卡交貨期約半年，部分產品訂單能見度達2年；VPC與MEMS探針卡產能今年擴增五成。
Taiwan News：MPI為懸臂式與垂直式探針卡全球最大市佔，滿載運轉，訂單排到2027年；2025年探針卡佔營收72.2%、合併營收NT$133.8億。
findings.excerpt: Mpi, which holds the largest global market share in both cantilever and vertical probe cards, is operating at full capacity as AI and high-performance computing applications drive stronger orders. Industry sources said its orders are booked through 2027, with further capacity expansions expected next year.

findings.claim: 傳聞（未經公司證實）旺矽探針卡擬調漲雙位數百分比，預計Q3末生效；法人認為有助下半年毛利率。
SEMI 2026年7月中期預測：全球半導體設備OEM銷售2026年達創高1659億美元，年增23.2%，2028年達2295億美元；WFE 2027年預計成長21.8%。
findings.source: SEMI mid-year forecast via search summary
findings.excerpt: Global sales of total semiconductor manufacturing equipment by original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) are forecast to reach a record high of $165.9 billion in 2026, increasing 23.2% year-on-year.

findings.claim: Focus Taiwan（2026-08-31）報導SEMICON Taiwan：全球半導體材料市場2026年830億美元、2027年920億美元，兩年皆雙位數成長。
Meticulous Research：全球探針卡市場2025年31.5億美元，2026年約40.3億美元，2036年95.4億美元，CAGR 9.0%；QYResearch稱前五大廠合計市佔約73%。
findings.excerpt: The global Probe Cards Market was valued at USD 3.15 billion in 2025. This market is expected to reach USD 9.54 billion by 2036 from an estimated USD 4.03 billion in 2026, registering a CAGR of 9.0% during the forecast period (2026-2036).
